info.name: BIBLIO API
info.description: Endpoint reference. Login user/admin captures real bearer tokens; protected bearer requests disable cookies to prevent stale cookie identities overriding the selected role. Logout revokes all sessions for that account. Use biblio.integration.postman_collection.json for the ordered nine-flow run.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register and sign in with HTTP-only cookie auth. Use the same cookie jar for protected endpoints.

exec: const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); if (pm.response.code === 200 && cookie) pm.collectionVariables.set('userToken', cookie.match(/token=([^;]+)/)[1]);
const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie'); if (pm.response.code === 200 && cookie) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', cookie.match(/token=([^;]+)/)[1]);

item.name: Create book as USER (403 failure case)

exec: pm.test('Loan includes book and due date', () => { pm.expect(data.borrow.book).to.exist; pm.expect(data.borrow.dueDate).to.exist; });
pm.test('Fines and balance returned', () => { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.fines).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.totalUnpaid).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Notification list and unread count returned', () => { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.notifications).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.unread).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('Ranked canonical books', () => { for (const result of pm.response.json().data.results) { pm.expect(result.book._id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/); pm.expect(result.relevance).to.be.within(0, 1); pm.expect(result.reason).to.be.a('string'); } });

pm.test('Attribution or explicit abstention', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.answer).to.be.a('string'); if (!d.insufficientContext) pm.expect(d.sources.length).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test('Schedule covers requested duration when supported', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (!d.insufficientContext) { pm.expect(d.steps[0].startWeek).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.steps[d.steps.length-1].endWeek).to.eql(8); } });
